survey: A black iron cauldron stands on a grey stone-tile floor, seen from a slightly raised three-quarter-front camera with the horizon near the top of the card. The rolled rim is an open, even ellipse (about 0.28 tall-to-wide) with green liquid and bubbles sitting level inside it. The round belly bulges below the rim and narrows into the underside. Two of the three stubby tapered legs are visible: a large front-left leg and a smaller rear-right leg. Each ends in a round foot whose ellipse is about as open as the rim's, and both feet sit flat on the floor. A small campfire of crossed sticks lies flat on the floor between the legs. The floor tiles form a grid that recedes diagonally and agrees with the camera height. There are two ring handles on opposite sides. The left ring is attached right under the rim and seen as a narrow loop. The right ring hangs from a square lug set clearly lower on the belly and is seen almost face-on as a full circle.

errors.where: The two side handles (left ring under the rim, right ring on a square lug)
errors.what: The handles sit on opposite sides of the pot at the same distance from the camera, so they should look like mirror images: same height and same foreshortening. Instead, the left ring is attached at rim level and drawn as a narrow, foreshortened loop. The right ring is attached noticeably lower on a boxy lug and drawn as an almost full circle facing the viewer. The two rings are seen from different angles, and the line between their mounting points tilts even though the rim is level.

fix: Cast-iron cauldron with two matching ring handles placed symmetrically on opposite sides, both attached at the same height just below the rim. Both rings are drawn with the same foreshortening for the three-quarter view from slightly above, each as a similar narrow oval loop, and the line between their mounting points is parallel to the rim ellipse.
